name: Talon's Arm and Core units
summary: The units Talon 1.03 adds to Arm and Core, on their builders' menus.
notes: Input is the 2026-10-16 local candidate ZIP, which retains the Core Prime preservation download's original archive bytes (upstream SHA-256 3922be8679f058769b92bb6028fb7193956073dbaec630e412a74254f2393100).
The units keep the stats Talon gave them; Talon's changes to Arm and Core's own units are not carried.

AAIGATE, CAIGATE, AAISILO and CAISILO are left out: the release's readme credits them as the Arm and Core AI Galactic Gates and AI nukes, made for its computer players (the gates cost 1 and make 31337 metal and energy; the AI nukes build ten times faster than the silos they copy). Nanolathe's Modern AI uses every unit a player may build.
